# VBO Advertising

> Founder-led marketing consultancy and studio in Miami, serving small to mid-size businesses across South Florida.

VBO Advertising is a Miami-based marketing consultancy and studio founded by Tim Bailey. We sit between strategic consulting and full-service agency, delivering senior-level thinking and hands-on execution without the layers or overhead. Services include marketing strategy, paid media, SEO, social media, brand strategy, website design, performance analytics, and creative production.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.vboadv.com/): Brand positioning, philosophy, services overview
- [Marketing for Law Firms in South Florida](https://www.vboadv.com/professional-services/law-firms): Vertical landing page for law firm marketing
- [AI-Enabled Marketing Agency](https://www.vboadv.com/ai-enabled-marketing): VBO's modern operational approach, comparing traditional vs AI-enabled vs AI-first agency models

## Service areas

Miami, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Doral, Aventura, Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Boca Raton, West Palm Beach, plus broader South Florida and US-wide for geography-independent services.

## Founder

Tim Bailey, founder of VBO Advertising. 10+ years of marketing experience across brands including McDonald's, Royal Caribbean, Formula E. Based in Miami.
